The Router assigned the `fine_grained_classifier` to verify if the cars are 'convertibles' (Checkpoint: Passenger car with retractable soft-top...). This task requires visual reasoning about geometry and parts, not just class probability. Additionally, the plan fails to assign an expert to verify the spatial relationship 'on top of' (Atom 4), relying solely on initial QA which noted fusion artifacts.
